description.zh: 应用ID列表。应用ID为调用[CreateAppInfo](~~CreateAppInfo~~)接口或[ListAppInfo](~~ListAppInfo~~)接口返回参数`AppId`的值。
description.en: The IDs of applications. You can obtain the application ID from the `AppId` parameter in the response to the [CreateAppInfo](~~CreateAppInfo~~) or [ListAppInfo](~~ListAppInfo~~) operation.

description.zh: OSS bucket地址。当StorageType为user_oss_bucket时，该字段必填。
description.en: The address of an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket. This parameter does not take effect. You can call this operation to add only VOD buckets.

descriptions.zh:
调用AddVodStorageForApp为视频点播子应用启用点播系统bucket。
 <notice>每个子应用最多启用一个点播系统bucket。传入不存在AppId或AppId已启用点播系统bucket会返回失败。</notice>
<notice>调用该接口需要调用者有应用管理员权限（VODAppAdministratorAccess），主账号默认有应用管理员权限，应用管理员可以调用AttachAppPolicyToIdentity为子账号或角色授权应用权限。</notice>
descriptions.en:
You can call this operation to add a buckets to an ApsaraVideo VOD applications.

> You can add only one ApsaraVideo VOD bucket for each application. If you specify an AppId that does not exist or the ID of an application for which an VOD bucket is enabled, an error is returned.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vod add-vod-storage-for-app --app-id app-0000 --storage-location example-bucket.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com --storage-type vod_oss_bucket --region cn-hangzhou
